items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: we're trying to convince Ed Fox. Ed Fox say, "Aw, that bum can't sing." I said, "Man, he can sing, man."

ctx.x: And, well, she went to Spelman. So, I persuaded her after a year, let's get married. So, sure enough, in 1935, we got married. In the mean time, one day sitting at home I got this phone call from Ed Fox. Now --
